prompt: The pier is open for spring break. It costs $5 per adult and $3 per child to fish on the pier. Fishing rods are $5 each to rent. Bait costs $3. A sandwich costs $4 and a soda costs $3. Souvenir t-shirts are $12 and hats are $8. How much would it cost two parents and their child to go fishing, including pier access, bait and fishing rods, souvenir t-shirts and hats, and a sandwich and soda for each person?

Emily is organizing a book drive for her school library. On the first day, she collects 48 books. She continues collecting books for a total of 5 days, and each day she collects 6 more books than the previous day. After the book drive, Emily decides to donate 15% of the total collected books to another school. How many books does Emily donate to the other school?

Moriah gets paid $50 per hour as a coder. She worked 68 hours this week as part of the overtime offered. Overtime pays her $75 per hour over 40 hours for that work week. She looked at her paystub and saw she'd taken home $3200 after taxes and insurance deductions. If the insurance deductions are 2% of her paycheck and the four tax-type deductions are split evenly, what percentage of her total paycheck is each tax-type deduction?

James is playing paintball. He keeps a score of how many people he downs and how many times he gets downed while playing. On Sunday, he downs 12 people and gets downed 1/2 as much. On Monday, he downs 1/4 as many people as he did on Sunday and only gets downed 2 times. On Friday, he downs 3 times as many people as he did on Monday and he got downed twice as much as he did on Sunday. On Saturday, he downed 6 times as many people as he did on Sunday and got downed 1/2 as much as he did on Friday. How many times did James get downed during paintball?

Anna will spend a total of $200 on shopping this weekend. She plans to buy 3 tops each costing $20, 2 pairs of pants each costing $15, and 2 pairs of shoes each costing $25. Anna also plans to get a hats that costs $15. How much money will be left with Anna after the shopping?

Billy, Bob, Sue, and Max work at a new car wash that dries all the customer’s vehicles. Management told the employees that it should take 5 minutes to fully towel dry an SUV and 3 minutes to fully dry a car. There are 6 SUVs and 4 cars in line. How many minutes will it take the group to dry all the vehicles?

Jim is a maintenance worker at a pool. The pool has 2000 liters of water. Every time a child jumps in the pool, they cause 200 mL of water to splash out. When an adult jumps in, they cause 400 mL of water to splash out. Jim has to get everyone out of the pool, clean, and refill it when 1/5 of the water has been splashed out. 20 kids and 60 adults jumped in the pool. How many more kids than adults would be able to jump in the pool before Jim has to refill it?

Kenishi, a thirteen-year-old boy looking to join the local dojo, decides to sign up for lessons. As he approaches the entrance gate, he sees that they have posted the physical requirements for new inductees at the entrance. Each person wishing to join the dojo must be able to perform at least three times as many pushups as their age, their age minus ten pullups, and five times as many situps as their age. Seeing this, what is the total number of repetitions that Kenishi must perform to induct himself into the dojo?

Officer Sherry's precinct has lots of criminal activity. When she comes in to make an arrest, she yells, "HANDS IN THE AIR," and counts the number of hands raised in the air to get an idea of how much time she'll spend fingerprinting. This week, she knew she was going to arrest the Peterson crime family, whose family averages 3.5 fingers per hand due to their dark, criminal past. The Rhodes crime family was also at the station waiting to be booked, and they averaged 5 fingers per hand. Sherry can fingerprint 3 fingers in a minute and it takes 30 minutes to finish paperwork. If there were 20 hands from the Peterson family and 13 from the Rhodes family, how many minutes did it take her to finish her paperwork and fingerprint all the criminals?
Jan usually pays $20 for her sandwich but today it's half off. If sales tax is usually 10% how much will she pay for her sandwich?

Jimmy plans to write some articles this week. He can write 1 article on Monday. Starting from Tuesday, every day he can write 1 more article than the previous day. He will submit all the articles written within this week to journals. Assuming that each journal can receive at most 4 articles at a time, how many journals will Jimmy submit his articles to?

Tony and Joanie both work full-time jobs. Tony makes $22/hr, and Joanie makes $18/hr. They also get a per diem of $20 and $25, respectively. If they both work 8 hours a day, how much total money, in dollars, do Tony and Joanie make together?

Four babies were born in a hospital on the same day. Sara weighed 6 pounds, Felipe weighed 8 pounds, and Issac weighed 5 pounds. If the total weight was 26 pounds, how many pounds did the last baby weigh?

Andy is walking in a Fourth of July parade throwing out candy. He has Tootsie Rolls and Lollipops, and he wants to make sure he has enough of both for the entire parade. He throws out two handfuls of each candy for every minute of the parade, and these handfuls have 16 pieces of candy in them. A bag of Tootsie Rolls comes with 112 pieces, and a bag of lollipops comes with 56 pieces. If the parade is 42 minutes long, how many more bags of lollipops does he need to buy than bags of Tootsie Rolls?

Julian has a budget of $6,000 for the renovation of his kitchen. He is going to spend 1/3 of that budget on countertops and 1/2 of the budget on a contractor. How much will be left over for him to use for appliances?

Minji wants to take her 70-year-old grandma to an all-you-can-eat buffet. The price for adults is $16 and the price is $5 less for senior citizens. How much will it cost for both Minji and her grandma to eat at the buffet?

Juana returned some holiday gifts to the store. One was valued at $60, another at $45, and the last at $35. The store offered to give her a 20% of the original value in cash, or $50 in store credit. She took the cash and used it to buy a $70 suit. How much money would she have saved on the suit if she had taken the store credit instead?

Kira wants to drink 8 cups of water throughout the day. In the morning she drink 1/4 of the total amount of water. By lunch she drinks 2 more cups of water. After dinner she drinks 3 more cups of water. How much water will Kira need to drink before bed?

Marian raises cats for adoption. Over a few years, she raised 62 litters, each of 12 cats. She split the cats into 4 groups to send to adoption agencies. One agency split their group of cats evenly between 3 rooms to meet with hopeful new foster parents. Marian is attached to all of the cats she puts out for adoption and checks up on them every 5 years. If this agency had 50 cats adopted from one room after 5 years, how many cats does the room have left?
Puck deposited $1,200 in his Roth IRA account. Braine deposited $120 less than twice the amount as Puck. How much did Braine deposit in his Roth IRA?

Audrey is a professional deep-sea fisherwoman with a knack for catching tuna. She can usually catch 705 on one trip out to sea. When she returns to shore and weighs anchor, she has to package the tuna in coolers to be shipped to markets, and each cooler can hold 5 tuna. Each market can only accept 3 coolers of tuna due to the size of walk-in refrigerators. How many markets can she send the maximum amount of coolers to?

Carl is trying to consume less than 90 grams of sugar per day. He had a can of Mountain Dew for breakfast that had 34 grams of sugar. He wants to eat some Twinkies for lunch. Each Twinkie has 4 grams of sugar. How many Twinkies can he eat while staying under his daily limit?
Maryann is saving up for a new bike that costs $450. She already has $120 saved up. She earns $15 per hour at her part-time job. How many hours does she need to work to afford the bike?

Penelope is a big coin collector. She opened her piggy bank to count the coins she had. When she opened it, she had 35 quarters, 16 dimes, 25 nickels, and 40 pennies. She was hoping to buy two new toys. Each toy costs $10.00. How much more does Penelope need to save to be able to buy both toys?

Tony is going grocery shopping for cake supplies. He buys 2 boxes of cake mix, 2 cartons of eggs, 1 bag of sugar, and 4 sticks of butter. A box of cake mix costs $3, one carton of eggs costs $2, a bag of sugar costs $6, and a stick of butter costs $1. If the sales tax is 10%, how much money, in dollars, will Tony pay for his cake supplies?
